title: Medium
description: One place or channel round a style: a salon, a club, a workshop, a school, a magazine, a publishing house, a gallery, an auction house or a web platform. A style does not own it. The medium names the styles that it carried and the part it took. Rule 4 of the curation rules: each style has at least one medium.

kind.description: salon: a juried or open show held again and again. club: a society or a group of members. workshop: a shop that makes and sells. school: a place that teaches. studio: a design or art collective. magazine: a periodical. publisher: a publishing house or a press. gallery: a dealer or a showroom. exhibition: one show. auction-house: a house that sells at auction. platform: a web site or an app where people post work.

founded.description: The first year. Null when no open source gives it. Do not guess a year.

closed.description: The last year. Null when it is still open, or when no open source gives it.

place.description: The city, or "web" for a platform.

part.description: launched: the style started here. exhibited: it showed the work. published: it printed or posted the work or the argument. taught: it trained the makers. made: it produced the work. sold: it traded the work. gathered: the makers met here.

people.description: Person ids from data/people/ who ran or shaped the medium.
